checks.title: Hyper-V role is installed and management cmdlets are available
checks.rationale: All subsequent Hyper-V checks depend on the role being installed.
checks.remediation: Install Hyper-V via Windows Features or 'Install-WindowsFeature Hyper-V'.

checks.title: Virtualization Based Security (VBS) is running
checks.rationale: VBS is the foundation for Credential Guard and HVCI on the Hyper-V host.
checks.remediation: Enable VBS via Group Policy or Device Guard configuration; ensure UEFI and TPM 2.0 are available.

checks.title: Hypervisor-protected Code Integrity (HVCI) is running
checks.rationale: HVCI enforces kernel code-signing using virtualization to reduce kernel-mode malware exposure.
checks.remediation: Enable Memory Integrity in Windows Security or via the Device Guard policy.

checks.title: Credential Guard is running
checks.rationale: Credential Guard isolates LSA secrets in a VBS-protected enclave.
checks.remediation: Enable Credential Guard via Group Policy: Computer Configuration > Admin Templates > System > Device Guard.

checks.title: All Gen2 VMs have Secure Boot enabled
checks.rationale: Secure Boot prevents unauthorized firmware/bootloader execution in guest VMs.
checks.remediation: For each Gen2 VM, run 'Set-VMFirmware -VMName <name> -EnableSecureBoot On'.

checks.title: All Gen2 VMs have a virtual TPM enabled
checks.rationale: vTPM enables BitLocker and other measured-boot protections inside guest VMs.
checks.remediation: For each Gen2 VM, run 'Enable-VMTPM -VMName <name>' (requires Host Guardian Service for key protection).

checks.title: Guest Service Interface is disabled where not required
checks.rationale: The Guest Service Interface allows file-copy and other host-to-guest operations; it should be off unless needed.

checks.title: Live Migration uses CredSSP or Kerberos (not legacy)
checks.rationale: Authenticated Live Migration prevents unauthorized VM movement between hosts.

checks.title: Live Migration uses compression or SMB (not uncompressed TCP/IP)
checks.rationale: Compressed/SMB Live Migration reduces clear-text replication time and exposure.

checks.title: Replica server uses certificate-based authentication only
checks.rationale: Certificate-based replication encrypts the channel and removes Kerberos delegation risk.
checks.remediation: Disable Kerberos on Set-VMReplicationServer or set certificate-only mode.

checks.title: Default virtual machine path is not on the system drive
checks.rationale: Hosting VMs on the OS drive risks runaway disk usage taking down the host.

checks.title: Default virtual hard disk path is not on the system drive
checks.rationale: VHD files on the OS drive risks runaway disk usage taking down the host.

checks.title: Review VMs with outstanding checkpoints/snapshots
checks.rationale: Long-lived checkpoints inflate VHD chains, slow IO, and create rollback risk.
checks.remediation: Merge or delete unused checkpoints with Remove-VMSnapshot.

checks.title: Review virtual switch inventory (counts by type)
checks.audit: Compare Get-VMSwitch output against your network architecture. External switches expose VMs to the physical LAN; Internal/Private isolate them.
checks.rationale: Switch type controls VM network exposure.
checks.remediation: Use Internal or Private switches for VMs that should not be reachable from outside the host.

checks.title: Review virtual network adapter port ACLs and VLAN tagging
checks.audit: Run 'Get-VMNetworkAdapterAcl' and 'Get-VMNetworkAdapterVlan' for each VM. Confirm ACLs and VLAN IDs match approved network segmentation.
checks.rationale: Per-adapter ACLs and VLANs enforce east-west isolation between guest VMs.
checks.remediation: Apply Add-VMNetworkAdapterAcl rules and Set-VMNetworkAdapterVlan as per your network design.

checks.title: Manual: verify shielded-VM Host Guardian Service configuration
checks.audit: If hosting shielded VMs, run 'Get-HgsClientConfiguration' and confirm attestation mode (TPM-trusted vs AD-trusted) matches policy.
checks.rationale: Shielded VMs require an attested HGS configuration to protect guest secrets.
checks.remediation: Configure HGS attestation and key protection per Microsoft's Shielded VM guide.
